analysis:
Examined both files' metadata, patches and all supplied source excerpts against the canonical definition index and supplied T-041 detail. These units change documentation only: changelog.d/coordinator-reconnect-stall.md:3-4 describes bounded reconnects and disconnected idle drains; docs/provider/cli-reference.md head:443-447 requires no remaining work and no registered session to omit acknowledgement, and head:1943 documents a 30-second handshake deadline with backoff. No concrete security regression is established by this documentation. Surrounding BASE text preserves terminal usage settlement for model switching (:328-345), native owner retirement (:439-443), confirmed process exit before logout/revocation (:551-571), and fresh authorization on restart (:157). No changes to encryption, prompt exposure, cache isolation (T-041), artifact qualification or fan authority are evidenced here.
Integration must verify CoordinatorConnectionHandshake.swift and CoordinatorClient+Connection.swift cancel timed-out sockets and reject late callbacks without retaining serving grants (TB-002, TB-011, T-053), and ProviderLoop+Lifecycle.swift counts unfinished terminal writes, local response owners and native retirement before accepting a disconnected drain. Check that drain admission remains fenced across reconnect/registration races and that ServiceDrain/logout still confirm process exit before credential deletion (A-008). The runtime implementations and tests are outside this batch; documented controls are not proof of enforcement. These material cross-file questions require reconciliation in the implementation review, not findings based solely on missing source.
